content.short: Paysend is a UK global money-transfer platform sending to over 170 countries by card, account or wallet.
content.description: Paysend, founded in 2017, is a UK-based global payments platform known for pioneering low-cost, card-to-card international money transfers. From its app, consumers can send money to bank accounts, cards, e-wallets and cash pickup across more than 170 countries, while Paysend Business gives companies multi-currency accounts, mass payouts and tools to pay suppliers and staff abroad. Paysend focuses on migrants, families and small businesses that need fast, affordable remittances without the markups of traditional banks. By building its own global network connecting cards, banks and local payment systems, it delivers quick transfers at flat or low fees, competing with other digital remittance and multi-currency providers.
content.meta: Paysend offers low-cost card-to-card and cross-border payments for people and business. Discover Paysend and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
